title: Notification Channel Hierarchy
scenario: A messaging module defines an abstract Notification base class with send(). EmailNotification and SmsNotification are concrete subclasses that inherit from Notification.
goal: Model the inheritance hierarchy connecting both concrete notification channels to their abstract base class.
learningObjective: Use Generalization arrows correctly from subclasses to an abstract superclass.
hints: Generalization uses a hollow triangular arrow pointing from child to parent.
Both EmailNotification and SmsNotification inherit from Notification.
Draw Generalization from EmailNotification -> Notification and SmsNotification -> Notification.
solutionExplanation: EmailNotification and SmsNotification both specialize the abstract Notification class via Generalization.

solutions.description: Abstract Notification superclass with two concrete subclasses
